summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB payload
details: This npm package advertises itself as an ESLint plugin but ships a `preinstall` script (`setup.mjs`) that runs unconditionally on `npm install`. The script downloads a Bun runtime binary from oven-sh's GitHub releases (platform-detected via `ldd`/`/etc/os-release`), unzips it to an OS temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it to run a bundled 727KB single-line obfuscated JavaScript file `math_init.js`. The payload uses obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (constant array `n7gIxM`, index-shuffling function `WV8StW`) so its actual behavior cannot be audited pre-execution. An ESLint rule plugin has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time or to execute an opaque 727KB blob. The package's declared version (1.3.8) also diverges from Bun target version string `V="1.3.13"` embedded in setup.mjs, and the shape (lifecycle-hook download of a second runtime used to execute an obfuscated sibling bundle) is inconsistent with the legitimate `@ornikar` ESLint plugin.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
